content:
mike: Anyone else seeing a big remote_write backlog in us-west? Grafana panel is screaming https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd/remote-write-queue?orgId=1
ashley: yep. Alert fired ~6:12am - prometheus_remote_write_queue_length > 10k for cluster-us-west-gpu.
len: I'm seeing scrape_duration_seconds spike for node-exporter and sidecars across many pods. Prometheus logs show lots of 'context deadline exceeded' and some 429s from remote write.
xia: This started right after the sidecar image bump yesterday that added a periodic heartbeat label on pods. Could be label cardinality blowup.
mike: remote_write_queue_length peaked at ~42k, remote_write_in_flight dropped, remote_write_errors includes 'rpc error: code = ResourceExhausted' and HTTP 429. Throughput down ~60%.
ashley: Can someone paste the relabel_config from the scrape job? I remember we added labelmap for pod labels and maybe it pulled too many keys.
len: Here is the relevant scrape_config we rolled out (from the config on one affected server):
```yaml
- job_name: 'kubernetes-pods'
  kubernetes_sd_configs:
    - role: pod
  relabel_configs:
    - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_heartbeat_id]
      target_label: heartbeat
      action: replace
    - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_env]
      target_label: env
    - action: labelmap
      regex: __meta_kubernetes_pod_label_(.+)
```
Note the labelmap + explicit heartbeat capture — heartbeat_id is a per-restart UUID from the sidecar.
xia: Yep that's the problem. heartbeat_id is high-cardinality (changes per container restart). The labelmap is sweeping up other pod_label_* keys too. We should drop anything matching pod_label_heartbeat.* or avoid labelmap on everything.
mike: Can we patch a relabel_config to drop the heartbeat label at scrape and reload config? Minimal change to stop new series.
ashley: Pushed a hotfix to prometheus config in us-west to add:
```yaml
- action: labeldrop
  regex: 'heartbeat|heartbeat_id|pod_label_heartbeat.*'
```
and removed the global labelmap for pod labels in that job. Reloading now.
len: After reload, remote_write_queue_length is starting to drain. Chromed the queue metrics: it's decreasing from 42k -> 8k and falling. Good sign.
xia: We'll need to run a tsdb cleanup window to evict those high-card series. But retention should expire them naturally. For safety, let's keep retention aggressive for that namespace.
mike: Created a follow-up ticket INF-1423 to audit all relabels that use labelmap and to add a test harness. https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-1423
ashley: Added a temporary suppression rule for the alert and lowered the threshold while we stabilize. Also added runbook notes: don't labelmap arbitrary pod labels.
len: One more note — this affected mainly gpu-node pools because autoscaler churned pods during a scale-up that produced a bunch of unique heartbeat IDs within minutes. So autoscaler timing + heartbeat label = blowout.
xia: Proposal: change sidecar to emit heartbeat as a metric or annotation with fixed value instead of per-start UUID label. And add a lint in CI to block new relabel labelmap changes without review.
mike: Agreed. Also add an SLO for remote_write throughput and a Grafana dashboard panel for relabel_changes_count.
deploy-bot: deploy completed: prometheus-config patch v2026-03-18-1 applied to cluster-us-west-gpu (rolling reload)
ashley: :thumbsup: queue draining, alert back to normal. I'll monitor for the next 12h and we can close INF-1423 when relabel audit is done.
